memo:
Basic IDE open, Module1. After focusing editor: ctrl+a then type macro:
Sub FixNum
oDoc=ThisComponent
For i=0 To oDoc.DrawPages.Count-1 : Red(oDoc.DrawPages.getByIndex(i)) : Next i
For i=0 To oDoc.MasterPages.Count-1 : Red(oDoc.MasterPages.getByIndex(i)) : Next i
oDoc.store()
End Sub
Sub Red(p): For j=0 To p.Count-1: s=p.getByIndex(j): If s.supportsService("com.sun.star.presentation.SlideNumberShape") Then s.CharColor=RGB(255,0,0) ... then F5 to run
